section_model: DTU chord/thickness/twist; FFA-W3-241/301/360 contours from pinned WISDEM reference; scaled thick root transition; static DTU-shape prebend
assumptions: World +X from hub towards nacelle rear, +Z upward; hub=(0,0,112).
Blade span is radial pitch-axis distance from root to tip; 2*(2+90)=184 m reference diameter.
Hub radius 2 m, root diameter 3.2 m, nacelle height 4 m and tower placement are visual assumptions.
Root chord blends from 3.2 m to independently scaled DTU chord over first 10 m; last 0.6 m closes to a tip.
Static 3.0 m upwind tip prebend, with normalized DTU C2-def Y distribution; assumed for GW184. Zero tilt/cone; no elastic displacement or controller model.
90 m is root-to-tip pitch-axis projection. Reference swept diameter at 0 deg pitch is 184 m; feathering rotates prebend into the rotor plane and slightly increases the envelope.
FFA contour family is a geometry reference; root adaptation and tip cap remain assumptions, not exact GW184/DTU blade surface.
